warning_source: Chairs of community emergency/resilience teams (Tzachi) in Nativ HaAsara, Yad Mordechai, Karmia, Zikim and Gevar’am
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; copies to Yoav Gallant, Herzi Halevi, Yuli Edelstein and Itamar Revivo
progress: Recovered the original contemporaneous dated letter and same-day N12 transmission report. The teams warned that recurring rocket fire followed by immediate normalization left Gaza-envelope communities in an intolerable cycle of emergency and demanded an initiatory/deterrent policy ending dependence on Hamas/PIJ whims. Published as WARN-33 at High confidence.
gaps: No direct acknowledgment by each copied recipient was recovered; government operational response remains unclear. Do not treat later Operation Shield and Arrow as caused by this letter without evidence.

status: Investigating / exact pre-Oct warning event unresolved
warning_source: Community emergency teams / regional councils responding to Ministry of Welfare readiness questionnaire
recipient: Ministry of Welfare and district/regional emergency-supervision chain; exact pre-Oct recipients unresolved
progress: A 2025 State Comptroller primary audit records that 37% of responding settlements reported no Tzachi exercise, 24% assessed their team preparedness as insufficient, and Sha’ar HaNegev Tzachi teams had zero orderly emergency-evacuation drills. August 2023 ministry data also showed 72 of 821 covered settlements had no Tzachi team.
gaps: The audit was performed after Oct. 7 and the public summary does not establish the exact date each questionnaire response was submitted or which results were escalated before Oct. 7. Recover questionnaire fielding/submission dates, Sha’ar HaNegev responses and pre-Oct distribution/response records before acceptance.

warning_source: Local councils, civilian security coordinators (rabbashatzim) and MOD/IDF workstream
recipient: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant / Ministry of Defense / IDF; exact warning source and pre-Oct transmission unresolved
progress: Later State Comptroller work documents longstanding settlement-defense, communications and rabbashatz-status weaknesses and says the defense minister had decided before the war to upgrade rabbashatz status. This supports a prewar institutional workstream but not yet one distinct qualifying warning event.
gaps: Recover Gallant's prewar instruction/order date, the staff-team appointment, source submissions from councils/rabbashatz bodies, and contemporaneous correspondence identifying concrete readiness/comms risks and recipients.

warning_source: Gaza-envelope local authority heads (including Ashkelon, Sderot, Eshkol, Sdot Negev and others)
progress: Contemporaneous Israel Hayom reports that after multi-front rocket escalation Netanyahu held calls with Gaza-envelope local heads, promised to advance a government program to strengthen the envelope and emergency preparedness, and the council heads demanded acceleration while raising additional challenges.
gaps: The retrieved report does not preserve a sufficiently specific warning/failure statement from the local heads. Recover minutes, council statements, letters or recordings showing the concrete risk they communicated before considering acceptance.

warning_source: Shin Bet / Ronen Bar security assessment chain
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu / senior decision-makers
progress: Later document-based Ynet investigation reports that Shin Bet again warned on 30 July of increased direction/initiation of West Bank attacks by Hamas commanders based in Gaza and urged a message to Sinwar; it reports Netanyahu declined killing someone in Gaza because of the risk of a round of fighting. This is a potential distinct warning/response event.
gaps: Need primary/full transcript or independently reproduced contemporaneous record, exact speaker/recipient attribution, and dedupe against WARN-4 and other late-July Bar warnings before acceptance. Do not rely on selectively released excerpts alone.
